hits.name: browser-qa
hits.description: Run automated post-deploy UI verification with a browser automation MCP (claude-in-chrome, Playwright, or Puppeteer): console-error and Core Web Vitals smoke checks, form and auth-flow interaction tests, screenshot visual regression across three breakpoints, and axe-core accessibility audits ending in a SHIP / DO-NOT-SHIP verdict. Use when testing a deployed feature on staging or preview, before shipping frontend changes, reviewing a frontend PR, or checking responsive layout and accessibility.
